chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his father (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Whoever withholds the zakat, it increases in his wealth."
ai.seo_question: What happens to the wealth of someone who withholds their zakat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from Sahih al-Tusi clarifies that withholding zakat does not incur a penalty of wealth reduction but rather results in an increase of barakah (blessing) or quantity, serving as a divine preparation for the Hereafter. This interpretation distinguishes the spiritual consequence of neglect from the legal obligation of payment to the Imam, emphasizing that the withheld amount remains part of the owner's wealth while accumulating spiritual weight.
